title: Split steam_compatibility.sh 663 -> 140 + four libraries
objective: steam_compatibility.sh is over the 250-line cap with no deployed copy. Split it into an entry script plus libraries grouped by the state each touches, so that no file assigns a global it never reads - the SC2034 constraint that decides where a shell seam can fall in this repo.
acceptance_criteria: All five resulting files are under 250 lines; the over-cap total falls 26 -> 25
Every library passes shellcheck standalone with no suppression
The script runs: --help prints usage and exits 0 through the split source graph
out_of_scope: The API paths, which need Steam credentials and a network round-trip
The phone_focus_mode scripts and the pacman-wrapper pair
verifier: bash meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh for the verbatim claim; bash steam_compatibility.sh --help for the runtime claim; shellcheck standalone on each library; bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all.
